conditions.imageFixture: One deterministic 256x256 PNG uploaded to the isolated room before timing; selected object draws it at 42x42, with other objects remaining circles.
conditions.drag: 60 trusted pointer moves at nominal 60 Hz, 1 warmup + 3 runs; DOM update + two rAF callbacks after pointer delivery
conditions.inputDiagnostics: Also records capture-listener to DOM mutation and actual delivered pointer spacing; excludes pre-delivery waiting and is not paint latency
conditions.playback: Three-second Scene, two one-second holds and one-second transition; rAF spacing, not physical FPS
conditions.profiling: CDP CPU sampler at 1 ms; includes measurement overhead
conditions.exclusions: No audio/video, WAN or hardware GPU; not field INP; fixture upload and initial image preparation are outside timing
